messages:
Ana: Draft of the Redwood Optimize launch blog is ready for review: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xExampleLink
Ana: TL;DR: announce Optimize, call out Dedicated availability, highlight up to 2x token cost reduction for mid-sequence workloads (with methodology), invite to webinar. Need copy edits, benchmark language, legal signoff, publish plan. Target publish: 2026-05-12 10:00 PDT.
Riley: Headline should say "Up to 2x" not "cut cost in half". Also add a short methodology blurb so customers know the assumptions.
Sam: Agree. Include workload assumptions (median seq length, batching config) and link to appendix/notebook.
Morgan: Benchmark config to cite: model=redwood-v2-xxl; batch_target=64; KV cache=on; context=16GB; microbatch=8; host offload disabled; quant=fp16. Run summary: median input=256 tokens, avg output=64 tokens. Costs normalized per 1M tokens.
Lee: Legal note: avoid comparative pricing claims vs competitors unless publicly sourced. Use phrasing like "in our tests" and include the methodology appendix. I'll review and sign off. Also check the gated asset privacy blurb.
Max: For tracking and lead routing use utm_source=blog, utm_medium=launch, utm_campaign=optimize_may2026. Form param source=blog_optimize to map to SFDC. Add hidden field benchmark_variant for A/B CTA. Gate the full benchmark notebook for MQLs and tag as benchmark_download.
Ana: We'll gate the notebook and wire HubSpot. Riley, can you add an anonymized customer snippet at the top?
Riley: Yep. Also will add a short "How to get started" with a concise API example: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-optimize-1","prompt":"Summarize...","max_tokens":64}'
Morgan: I'll add a CMS publish hook to emit a blog_publish webhook with UTM fields so Growth can pick up leads. Need exact field names.
Max: Webhook payload fields: utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, gclid (optional), campaign_id, lead_flow=benchmark_download.
Morgan: Got it. I'll attach the publish script and confirm when live.
deploy-bot: Scheduled publish job created: blog/optimize -> 2026-05-12T10:00:00-07:00. Status: scheduled.
Ana: Final action items: Ana update doc with methodology & appendix links; Morgan confirm webhook/publish; Lee legal signoff; Riley proof; Max/growth produce gated asset and UTMs. I'll ping when ready for final read.
Riley: I'll do grammar pass Mon AM.
Lee: Legal will complete review by Mon EOD.
Max: HubSpot webinar listing created; gating flow and MQL mapping ready.
All: :white_check_mark:
